nodes.title: Contracts, Schemas, Governance & Architecture Gates

axiomatic.fr: Enforce single-source-of-truth schemas, 5-layer isolation, security registers, and compatibility rules in CI.
axiomatic.dp: Declarative TOML/Proto/Cedar/YAML contracts under contracts/ and security/ validated by grdr-schema-lint, scripts/check-architecture.mjs, and cargo-deny.
axiomatic.pv: Live repo descriptor parity tests, schema-lint adversarial suites, and architectural graph checks.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Generally uncoupled in schemas; coupled to Rust code via manually duplicated constants (GRDR-*-NNNN literals, DataClass drift, hardcoded compliance/compat tables).

nodes.p14_notes: Event/schema registries and capture matrices are generated from contracts/, while error codes, compat matrices, and compliance crosswalks still duplicate data in Rust.
acceptance_criteria: All contracts compile and pass grdr-schema-lint and check-architecture.mjs without drift.
gaps: Multiple contracts (error codes, compat matrix, compliance crosswalks) are shadowed by hardcoded Rust constants; proto v1alpha1 has not reached v1 freeze (04-29).

friction_lens.first_time_user: Hidden contract gates (vocab lint, licence headers, security-audit stamps) surprise new contributors unless CLI guides remediation.
friction_lens.operator: limits.toml and support.toml cleanly document caps, but version skew rejection relies on incomplete hardcoded compat tables.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a protobuf field is strictly gated and safe via codegen, but adding an error code or compliance mapping still requires Rust edits.

nodes.title: Core Analysis, Policy Runtime, Attribution, Discovery & IPC

axiomatic.fr: Provide deterministic pre-execution normalization, policy evaluation, behavioral detection, session attribution, agent discovery, and fail-safe bindings.
axiomatic.dp: Pure sans-IO Engine in grdr-core, shared domain models in grdr-model, port traits in grdr-ports, bounded IPC in grdr-wire, and no_std fastpath floor evaluation.
axiomatic.pv: Unit/integration suites across grdr-core, grdr-fastpath, grdr-wire, and grdr-ports-testkit.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: grdr-core concentrates analysis, policy, detection, audit, and session modules via same-layer edges; discovery, attribution graph, and multi-vendor hook broker remain unbuilt or stubbed.

nodes.p14_notes: Multiple core modules (grdr-model::eval, grdr-core::policy::{signals,signals_scan,essentials_cedar}, grdr-core::analyze::{risk,path_rules}, grdr-fastpath::scanner, grdr-agents::{discover,artifacts}, grdr-broker) embed inline rule/agent/host lists instead of reading packs.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end deterministic core decisioning, 4-pass discovery, K1-K6 attribution, and L2 multi-vendor hook broker work across all Tier 1 platforms.
gaps: Discovery (05), Attribution Graph (06), and HookBroker/SDK (07) are major incomplete or missing slices tracked under Issue #119.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Built-in policy/detection evaluates quickly standalone, but discovery only sees 7 hardcoded agents and misreports protected hooks as AL3.
friction_lens.operator: Core engine works reliably offline with floor fallback, yet attribution cannot trace child processes, Docker/SSH hops, or shared terminals.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a new agent, protected path rule, or verdict provider requires modifying Rust enums and static slices across 5+ crates.

nodes.title: Cedar Policy Engine, Packs, Reference Oracle & Threat Intel

axiomatic.fr: Evaluate multi-layer monotonic Cedar policies with strict P7 safety, fast-path floor compilation, differential oracle verification, and restrict-only intel packs.
axiomatic.dp: Cedar 4.x Engine + monotonic narrowing compiler + independent grdr-policy-ref differential reference + Ed25519 signed pack bundles.
axiomatic.pv: Differential tests between grdr-core and grdr-policy-ref plus AARM R1-R9 conformance tests.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Policy evaluator engine is clean, but Essentials pack content is fragmented across three unsynced copies and YAML policy lists are bypassed at runtime.

nodes.p14_notes: packs/*/lists/*.yaml are largely ignored in production policy signal extraction in favor of Rust static arrays; only 3/14 packs are signed.
acceptance_criteria: Single authoritative Essentials policy pack loaded cleanly from signed pack data with monotonic multi-layer enforcement.
gaps: Three conflicting definitions of Essentials rules; partial native compile-down skips Exec/allow/protect rules; unsigned default policy packs.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Hardcoded Essentials fallback works immediately without setup, creating false confidence that editing packs/essentials/*.cedar takes effect everywhere.
friction_lens.operator: Cannot safely rely on packs/essentials/lists/protected-paths.yaml updates taking effect inside floor tables or signal scanners.
friction_lens.extender: Authoring a new policy list YAML file has zero runtime effect unless matched by custom Cedar or Rust code edits.

nodes.title: Cryptographic Boundary, Signing, AEAD & TUF/DSSE Updates

axiomatic.fr: Isolate all cryptographic primitives behind grdr-crypto and verify all software/content updates offline via two-root TUF + DSSE.
axiomatic.dp: Ed25519/XChaCha20-Poly1305/SHA-256/HMAC-SHA-256 in grdr-crypto enforced via architecture.toml, plus pure-Rust TUF+DSSE+A/B slots in grdr-update.
axiomatic.pv: Unit tests, Air-Gap S-31 conformance suite, and architecture lint blocking sha2/crypto deps outside grdr-crypto.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Strong isolation of primitives; however CanonicalReceipt signing omits provenance/session_state_seq/bundle_digest, and FIPS 140-3/HSM/KMS hardware roots are absent.

nodes.p14_notes: Cryptographic primitives and TUF verification are mechanism-level rather than policy content; trust roots load cleanly from packs/trust-roots.toml.
acceptance_criteria: Sole-crypto boundary passes lints, TUF+DSSE+rollback tests pass, FIPS profile satisfies B3 with audited provider.
gaps: Missing FIPS 140-3 crypto backend/SBOM verification (B3), CanonicalReceipt excludes provenance/bundle_digest, custom TUF client used instead of audited tough.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Key generation and signed offline receipts work automatically on first launch.
friction_lens.operator: Air-gap DSSE bundle approval enforces terms acceptance and multi-signer quorum cleanly, though FIPS/KMS hardware key custody is unavailable.
friction_lens.extender: Domain-separated signing and AEAD APIs are clean, except error codes are hardcoded rather than imported from registry.

nodes.title: Local Spool, Flight Recorder, Relational Stores, Event Lake, Blob, Bus & Jobs

axiomatic.fr: Provide crash-safe endpoint spooling/flight recording and dual-profile server storage adapters (embedded SQLite vs HA/distributed PostgreSQL + NATS + Lake + S3).
axiomatic.dp: grdr-store-local SegmentedSpool/FlightRecorderDb/Checkpoint + embedded adapters (SQLite/SqliteLogBus/FilesystemBlobStore/SqliteJobJournal) + HA wire adapters.
axiomatic.pv: grdr-ports-testkit contract suites and spool recovery tests.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Endpoint spool/recorder and embedded SQLite stack are thorough, whereas HA adapters diverge critically from production readiness (Postgres rejects TLS and falls back to SQLite offline; Lake uses SQLite+Blob AEAD instead of DataFusion+Parquet; NATS lacks auth/TLS/consumer wire reads).

nodes.p14_notes: Storage engines implement infrastructure ports; retention/capture configs load from limits.toml and capture.toml.
acceptance_criteria: Both embedded and HA profiles pass full durability, TLS/auth, multi-node concurrency, and scale benchmarks.
gaps: grdr-rel-postgres blocks sslmode require/verify-full; grdr-lake does not use DataFusion/Parquet/Iceberg; grdr-bus-nats relies on in-memory mutex for fetch/consume.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Local spool, SQLite recorder, and embedded server storage initialize zero-config out of the box.
friction_lens.operator: Cannot deploy HA/distributed server profile securely with TLS-encrypted PostgreSQL or clustered JetStream/DataFusion.
friction_lens.extender: grdr-ports-testkit contracts are comprehensive for verifying new storage adapters, though grdr-ports-kitkey sealing is absent.

nodes.title: Pseudonymisation, Identity Vault, Credential Broker & Secret Custody

axiomatic.fr: Prevent raw secret exposure to agents via two-tier pseudonyms, dual-approver re-identification vault, OS secret stores, and short-lived scoped credential brokering.
axiomatic.dp: Device+org HMAC pseudonyms, AEAD-sealed IdentityVault, DPAPI/Keychain/Linux-Keyring/OpenBao SecretStores, SPIFFE ceilings, AWS/GCP/GitHub/OAuth2 issuers, and YAML credential locators.
axiomatic.pv: grdr-identity unit tests, locator conformance checks, and credential helper vector tests.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Strong cryptographic/protocol mechanics in grdr-identity, yet credential locator scanning is disconnected from grdr-agents discovery and phantom-token runtime enforcement lacks kernel peer containment verification (TM-19).

nodes.p14_notes: Credential locators and H1-H12 hygiene rules load dynamically from packs/credential-locator/lists/*.yaml (one of the strongest P14 implementations in the repo).
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end brokered token injection constrained by OS peer + containment verification and credential store discovery across all Tier 1 hosts.
gaps: grdr-agents discovery does not invoke grdr-identity credential locators; TM-19 kernel-peer phantom-token enforcement not integrated across proxy/containment runtime; live STS issuers untestable offline without cloud accounts.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Secret stores protect local vault keys automatically via DPAPI/Keychain/keyring when available.
friction_lens.operator: Re-identification dual-approver quorum works cryptographically, but live IdP pseudonym continuity and cloud STS brokering require external setup.
friction_lens.extender: Adding new credential store regex/globs works purely via packs/credential-locator/lists/locators.yaml without Rust edits.

nodes.title: 5-Layer Workspace Boundaries & Architecture Linter

axiomatic.fr: Enforce acyclic 5-layer dependency DAG, sole crypto crate boundary, and parser isolation away from privileged processes.
axiomatic.dp: cargo metadata checked against [package.metadata.grdr] and contracts/architecture.toml via check-architecture.mjs.
axiomatic.pv: CI execution of node scripts/check-architecture.mjs.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Layer enforcement works on workspace crates, but architecture has drifted from doc 03 plan (47 crates instead of 24; missing grdr-ports-kitkey and grdr-wire-testkit; ARCH-025 Dialer seam in grdr-uplink rather than grdr-wire).

nodes.p14_notes: Build-time architectural invariant.
acceptance_criteria: check-architecture.mjs passes with zero unexpected same-layer edges and complete alignment with doc 03 & architecture.toml.
gaps: grdr-ports-kitkey and grdr-wire-testkit named in doc 03 / deny.toml do not exist in crates/.
ARCH-025 network Dialer lives in programs/grdr-uplink/src/dialer.rs rather than grdr-wire.
grdr-core has 3 authorized same-layer edges (grdr-crypto, grdr-fastpath, grdr-model) that concentrate multi-module coupling inside layer 1.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Clear error output when Cargo dependency violates layer ordering.
friction_lens.operator: Assurance relies on build-time lint guarantees holding across all binaries including excluded bpf/ and desktop/.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a new crate requires updating both [package.metadata.grdr] and contracts/architecture.toml.

nodes.title: Canonical Protobuf Packages & Unknown-Field Codec

axiomatic.fr: Guarantee deterministic binary wire encoding preserving unknown forward-compatible fields across all event and API contracts.
axiomatic.dp: Hand-aligned Rust types in grdr-proto backed by prost 0.14, embedded proto.binpb descriptor set, KnownFieldTags macro, and UnknownFields preservation.
axiomatic.pv: crates/grdr-proto/tests/descriptor_parity.rs verifies descriptor-to-Rust tag parity.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Decoupled from generated bindings via manual KnownFieldTags lists; prost 0.14 alone is used without buffa soak (SP-1 never compared both codecs); schemas remain pre-freeze v1alpha1.

nodes.p14_notes: Proto packages and option metadata derive package namespace/options from brand manifest (04-4).
acceptance_criteria: v1 freeze readiness (04-29), buf breaking FILE mode, and cross-binding byte-identical golden soak.
gaps: SP-1 dual-codec soak (buffa vs prost) was bypassed in favor of prost-only plus manual KnownFieldTags tables.
All canonical telemetry/API schemas remain at v1alpha1; 04-29 v1 freeze, 04-28 S-01 volume measurement table replacement, and external consumer check remain incomplete.
Proto wire structs and KnownFieldTags are maintained alongside generated proto.binpb, risking manual tag synchronization overhead.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Pre-generated descriptors let workspace compile without needing protoc/buf installed locally.
friction_lens.operator: Forward-unknown fields 900..999 are preserved safely through archive pipes.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a new proto message requires updating proto files, regenerating proto.binpb, and updating Rust structs + KnownFieldTags.

nodes.title: Schema Lint, Codegen, Capture Filter Matrix & Reclassifications

axiomatic.fr: Require every telemetry field to carry a verified data class, enforce capture-level minimization, and prevent silent schema/registry drift.
axiomatic.dp: grdr-schema-lint parses proto.binpb, validates SL01..SL13 options, generates fields.json/registry.rs/capture.rs deterministically, and checks sealed twins (04-19).
axiomatic.pv: live_repo.rs, schema_rules.rs, and adversarial_r3.rs verify drift detection and symlink-safe directory traversal.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Clean unidirectional flow: proto.binpb + capture.toml + brand.toml -> codegen -> generated Rust/JSON.

nodes.p14_notes: Fully data-driven codegen from proto descriptors, brand.toml, capture.toml, and reclassifications.toml.
acceptance_criteria: Zero missing data_class fields; deterministic --check fails CI on any generated artifact mismatch.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Automatic codegen sync checks catch forgotten field annotations immediately.
friction_lens.operator: Capture matrix guarantees sensitive bodies stay withheld locally at default metadata tier.
friction_lens.extender: Clear SL-error diagnostics point to exact proto file/field missing annotation.

nodes.title: Error Code Registry, Privacy DataClass Alignment & Vocabulary

axiomatic.fr: Standardize GRDR-<AREA>-<NNNN> diagnostic codes, privacy data classes, and non-em-dash Guardrails terminology across Rust and UI.
axiomatic.dp: contracts/codes/registry.toml checked by script/lint; vocabulary.toml enforced by vocab_lint; LogSafe/Redacted wrappers in grdr-model.
axiomatic.pv: vocab_lint tests and check-architecture.mjs code registry verification.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Two competing DataClass definitions exist (grdr-schema::DataClass 4 variants vs grdr-model::log_safe::DataClass 6 variants); raw GRDR-*-NNNN literals are duplicated inline inside error enums rather than generated from registry.toml.

nodes.p14_notes: Error strings like GRDR-CRYPTO-0001..0008, GRDR-COMPAT-0001..0003, GRDR-WIRE-0001..0008, GRDR-POL-0001..0010 are hardcoded manually in source files alongside registry.toml.
acceptance_criteria: Single generated error-code constant table and unified P8 DataClass enum across schema and model.
gaps: grdr-model::log_safe::DataClass (Public, Metadata, Identifier, Pseudonym, Content, Secret) diverges from canonical grdr-schema::brand::DataClass (Identifier, Structural, Derived, Content).
Error enums embed raw GRDR-*-NNNN string literals manually rather than referencing generated constants from contracts/codes/registry.toml.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Consistent coded errors are easy to grep across docs and logs.
friction_lens.operator: Split DataClass enums create subtle translation mapping risks between event archive filters and runtime logging.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a new coded error requires duplicating the code string in Rust source and registering it in registry.toml.

nodes.title: Plans, Surfaces, Support Matrix & Compatibility Negotiator

axiomatic.fr: Reject incompatible component/pack/driver/wire versions before activation while preventing hidden feature-flag boolean proliferation in plans.
axiomatic.dp: grdr-compat SemVer + VersionRange checks + contracts/support.toml & surfaces.toml + plans.toml lint in check-architecture.mjs.
axiomatic.pv: grdr-compat unit tests (2 tests) and grdr-schema limits tests (4 tests).
axiomatic.coupling_notes: grdr-compat is completely uncoupled from contracts/support.toml and live binary manifests; it uses a hardcoded static table.

nodes.p14_notes: grdr-compat::CompatMatrix::default_v1() hardcodes literal components (grdr-daemon, grdr-mcp, grdr-desktop) and version strings in Rust instead of reading support.toml or build-manifest compat blocks.
acceptance_criteria: grdr-compat evaluates build-manifest compat graphs against schema, pack_format, driver_interface, and wire versions loaded from contract files.
gaps: grdr-compat::default_v1() is a hardcoded mock matrix ignoring support.toml and driver_interface/pack_format/schema contracts.
No runtime compat block handshake verified across grdr-daemon/grdr-updater/packs.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Clear compatibility errors when mismatch happens inside default matrix.
friction_lens.operator: Mixed-version fleet rollouts cannot detect sensor driver_interface or pack_format mismatches from support.toml.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a new binary/adapter requires editing grdr-compat::default_v1() Rust code (P14 violation).

nodes.title: Cedar 4.x Plane Schemas (Runtime, Console, Operator)

axiomatic.fr: Strictly type-check every Cedar policy across runtime decision, tenant console RBAC, and provider operator planes.
axiomatic.dp: Cedar 4.x schemas embedded in grdr-schema::cedar and validated in ValidationMode::Strict.
axiomatic.pv: crates/grdr-schema/src/cedar.rs unit tests and grdr-schema-lint live_repo checks.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Well-isolated schema boundary shared by policy compiler and pack linter.

nodes.p14_notes: Schemas are standalone declarative .cedarschema contract files.
acceptance_criteria: Strict validation rejects any policy referencing undeclared action, attribute, or fact types.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Immediate syntax and schema feedback when authoring Cedar policies.
friction_lens.operator: Console and operator planes cannot cross-pollute runtime decision schema entities.
friction_lens.extender: Can extend facts cleanly under typed Context / Grdr entity extensions.

nodes.title: Threat/Requirement Register, Trust-Core Paths & Supply-Chain Policy

axiomatic.fr: Trace every threat actor/kill-chain stage to verified security requirements and gate dependencies/unsafe usage in CI.
axiomatic.dp: YAML threat & requirement registers + trust-core path triggers + cargo-deny allow-lists + unsafe-register + gitleaks/zizmor/vet configs.
axiomatic.pv: cargo deny check and security audit CI workflows + supply-chain fixture tests.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Policy configuration aligns mostly with doc 02/03, but diverges from actual workspace dependencies (rsigma policy vs custom parser; nonexistent grdr-ports-kitkey wrapper; RUSTSEC-2026-0543 ignored for chrono via cedar-policy-core).

nodes.p14_notes: Declarative YAML/TOML registers under security/.
acceptance_criteria: All SR items mapped to verified tests; zero unvetted dependencies or unapproved unsafe code.
gaps: security/deny.toml carries an ignore exception for RUSTSEC-2026-0543 (chrono in cedar-policy-core).
security/deny.toml references crates/grdr-ports-kitkey wrapper rules even though grdr-ports-kitkey does not exist.
security/requirements.yaml references SRs whose underlying runtime components (HookBroker, 4-pass discovery, attribution graph, Postgres TLS) remain incomplete.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Automated hooks explain why a blocked dependency or trust-core change needs judge verification.
friction_lens.operator: Comprehensive supply-chain fixtures prove cargo-deny and licence-lint gates work.
friction_lens.extender: Trust-core changes trigger dual-model security audit gates cleanly.

nodes.title: Compliance Capabilities, Framework Crosswalks, OSCAL & RFP Engine

axiomatic.fr: Map platform capabilities onto compliance controls, evaluate retention/legal holds, and export signed OSCAL/RFP artifacts from pack data.
axiomatic.dp: grdr-comply implements OSCAL 1.2.3 export, signed offline evidence bundles, legal holds ledger, retention resolution, and RFP parity matrix.
axiomatic.pv: crates/grdr-comply/tests/compliance_flow.rs and conformance pack_compliance validation.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Violates P14 decoupling: packs/compliance/controls/*.yaml mirrors data that grdr-comply::default_registry() hardcodes as CAPABILITY_DEFS/FRAMEWORK_SPECS/CROSSWALK_DEFS Rust const arrays.

nodes.p14_notes: grdr-comply reads static Rust arrays in catalog_*.rs; pack_compliance.rs merely checks YAML parity rather than grdr-comply loading packs/compliance/ dynamically at runtime.
acceptance_criteria: grdr-comply loads capabilities, frameworks, and crosswalks dynamically from verified packs/compliance YAML.
gaps: grdr-comply::default_registry() hardcodes capability/framework/crosswalk tables in Rust instead of loading packs/compliance/controls/*.yaml.
CM-1..CM-3 competitive capability data repository/scanners from Doc 01 are largely absent outside grdr-comply.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Built-in OSCAL/RFP exports work immediately via grdr comply without pack paths configured.
friction_lens.operator: Can audit retention floor/ceiling conflicts and legal holds programmatically.
friction_lens.extender: Adding a framework control requires updating both packs/compliance/ YAML and Rust const tables in grdr-comply/src/catalog_*.rs.

nodes.title: Core Domain Enums, Receipt Types & LogSafe Taxonomy

axiomatic.fr: Provide strongly typed closed action/verdict/assurance enums, LogSafe redaction wrappers, and canonical receipt signing structures.
axiomatic.dp: 15 closed ActionClass variants, 5 Verdict variants, Mode, AssuranceLevel/AssuranceRecord, Redacted<T>/OpaqueDigest, and SigningKeypairExt.
axiomatic.pv: Unit tests in domain.rs, eval.rs, log_safe.rs, signing.rs, proto_conv/enums_ops.rs.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Mixes pure domain types with hardcoded Essentials policy pack evaluation rules in eval.rs (P14 violation) and splits DataClass taxonomy from grdr-schema.

nodes.p14_notes: grdr-model/src/eval.rs hardcodes PACK_ESSENTIALS_ID="pack-essentials-slice0" and 7 literal policy rules (paths/patterns/Cedar strings) inside Layer 1.
acceptance_criteria: Pure domain structs with zero embedded policy rule content and single DataClass alignment with grdr-schema.
gaps: eval.rs embeds a legacy slice0 copy of Essentials rules contradicting packs/essentials/.
log_safe::DataClass defines 6 classes conflicting with grdr-schema::DataClass (4 classes + ContentKind).
signing.rs CanonicalReceipt omits provenance, session_state_seq, and bundle_digest fields needed for exact replay fidelity (04-13, 04-14).

friction_lens.first_time_user: Type serialization and closed vocabulary enums prevent invalid JSON inputs cleanly.
friction_lens.operator: Redacted<T> guarantees Debug/Display cannot accidentally dump secrets to console logs.
friction_lens.extender: Must delete legacy eval.rs essentials_pack() once policy packs are always loaded from disk/signed store.

nodes.title: Hexagonal Port Traits & In-Memory Conformance Testkit

axiomatic.fr: Isolate backend storage, event lake, message bus, blob, job, AI judge, DLP, and OS sensor/sandbox capabilities behind testable hexagonal traits.
axiomatic.dp: grdr-ports traits with SingleCtx/TenantCtx tenant isolation + FencingToken concurrency control + grdr-ports-testkit memory reference adapters and contract assertions.
axiomatic.pv: Contract assertion harnesses for RelationalStorePort, EventsPort, BusPort, BlobPort, and JobPort.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Traits and contract tests are solid, but doc 03 E1/E2 mechanisms (grdr-ports-kitkey sealing memory/test adapters out of release binaries and dist.toml profile closure resolver) are unimplemented.

nodes.p14_notes: Port abstractions only; backend selection is profile/config-driven.
acceptance_criteria: grdr-ports-kitkey seals Memory* testkit adapters from production release closures; dist.toml resolver enforces profile closure (GRDR-CFG-0007).
gaps: Missing crates/grdr-ports-kitkey crate specified by doc 03 ARCH-029 and security/deny.toml.
Missing dist.toml adapter distribution manifest and profile closure gate (E2).

friction_lens.first_time_user: Contract assertions quickly prove if an adapter respects tenant scoping and fencing tokens.
friction_lens.operator: Risk of memory reference adapters linking accidentally if kitkey boundary is absent.
friction_lens.extender: Implementing a new storage backend has a clear contract suite to run against.

nodes.title: Wire Framing, Root-Down Endpoint Verification & Mutual Peer Auth

axiomatic.fr: Authenticate both endpoints of local UDS/Named Pipe IPC against squatting/privilege escalation and enforce bounded length-prefixed framing.
axiomatic.dp: Root-down lstat owner/permission checks in grdr-wire/src/endpoint.rs + OS-native peer credential lookup in grdr-peer-os + transport in grdr-ipc-os.
axiomatic.pv: wire_ipc_tests.rs, os_ipc_server_tests.rs, os_peer_live_tests.rs.

acceptance_criteria: Mutual peer verification passes on Linux x64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64/2025 CI runners with zero squatted-endpoint bypasses.

friction_lens.operator: Cross-OS privilege edge cases (like Windows LA SIDs) fail closed when unrecognized, blocking runner/admin automation until fixed.
friction_lens.extender: Clean separation between logical grdr-wire protocol rules and OS-specific grdr-ipc-os / grdr-peer-os crates.

nodes.title: Command Shell Canonicalisers, Payload Decoders & Path/Net/Risk Analysers

axiomatic.fr: Canonicalise POSIX/PowerShell/Cmd commands, decode nested encodings, normalize paths/SSRF IPs, and classify risk signals deterministically.
axiomatic.dp: Hand-written bounded POSIX/PS/Cmd lexers+expanders (with depth/byte limits), base64/zlib decoders, SSRF IP classifier, and path canonicalizer.
axiomatic.pv: 39 unit tests across analyze/*.rs covering dialects, wrappers, decode bombs, symlinks, net CIDR/SSRF, and MCP diff.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Parsers work robustly inside tight budgets, though doc 03 planned brush-parser for POSIX; risk/path matchers hardcode pattern tables instead of pack lists.

nodes.p14_notes: crates/grdr-core/src/analyze/risk.rs (256-352) and path_rules.rs (31-191) hardcode protected paths, secret regex/prefixes, and destructive command matches in Rust instead of loading packs/*/lists/*.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Command/path normalization emits deterministic facts and loads protected path/command lists from signed policy packs.
gaps: risk.rs and path_rules.rs bypass packs/*/lists/*.yaml by embedding hardcoded match strings (P14 violation).
Tool-table normalization from doc 04 E3 (04-10..04-12, unmapped tool coverage-gap finding) is missing a declarative YAML tool-table interpreter.

friction_lens.first_time_user: Multi-shell deobfuscation catches encoded PowerShell and recursive sh -c wrappers accurately.
friction_lens.operator: Customizing sensitive path classification requires Rust changes rather than policy list updates.
friction_lens.extender: Bounded parser design protects daemon/engine from exponential expansion bombs cleanly.

nodes.title: Installed Agent, MCP & Artifact Config Scanner

axiomatic.fr: Discover installed coding agents, MCP configs, skills, plugins, and running agent processes across Windows/macOS/Linux from dynamic catalogue data.
axiomatic.dp: grdr-agents scans 7 hardcoded home/appdata config paths + artifacts routes + Windows CIM/tasklist subprocess fallback.
axiomatic.pv: Unit tests in discover.rs, artifacts.rs, windows_discovery.rs.
axiomatic.coupling_notes: Strongly coupled to hardcoded agent specs; grdr-core/src/discover.rs itself is a 37-line stub with only summarize_coverage().

acceptance_criteria: Catalogue loaded dynamically from packs/catalogue/ covering 16+ Tier A/B agents with accurate AL2/AL1 assurance and native OS APIs.

A: P14 / P17 Essentials & Policy-List Divergence: Three incompatible definitions of Essentials rules exist (grdr-model/src/eval.rs pack-essentials-slice0 7 rules, grdr-core/src/policy/essentials_cedar.rs ESSENTIALS_PARITY_CEDAR 9 rules, packs/essentials/rules/essentials.cedar 8 rules). Furthermore, packs/*/lists/*.yaml (except packs/credential-locator/) are not consumed at runtime; grdr-core/src/policy/{signals,signals_scan}.rs, grdr-core/src/analyze/{risk,path_rules}.rs, and grdr-fastpath/src/scanner.rs hardcode match strings, hosts, and patterns directly in Rust.

Major Incomplete Platform Slices (Tracked by Open Issue #119): Doc 05 (4-pass discovery, dynamic packs/catalogue/, packs/building-blocks/, Program Identity grammar, ABOM CycloneDX 1.7), Doc 06 (Attribution K1-K6 joins, OS container adoption, hop lineage, evidence grade calculus, session_edge graph, outward marks), Doc 07 L2 multi-vendor HookBroker / VerdictProvider / providers.d/ / spec/hook-broker/, and Python/TS sdk/ are missing or stubbed (crates/grdr-core/src/discover.rs is a 37-line summarize_coverage stub; grdr-agents hardcodes 7 agents, misclassifies Protected hooks as AL3/ScopedBoundary instead of AL2/Request, and shells out to powershell.exe/tasklist.exe).

HA / Distributed Storage Profile Production Gaps: grdr-rel-postgres explicitly rejects TLS (sslmode=require|verify-ca|verify-full) over TCP wire and emulates Postgres via in-memory SQLite offline; grdr-lake implements SQLite+AEAD blob segments rather than Doc 03/deny.toml DataFusion+Parquet+Iceberg lake; grdr-bus-nats sends unencrypted TCP HPUB without NKey/TLS auth and answers fetch/subscribe purely from an in-process Mutex; grdr-blob lacks an S3/ObjectStore adapter.

Custom Parsers Bypassing Doc 03 / Security Tool Choices: grdr-core/src/detect/ implemented custom pure-Rust YAML (yaml.rs) & Sigma (sigma.rs with 30 hardcoded PINNED_SIGNED_CORE_RULE_SHA256 hashes) parsers instead of rsigma-parser/rsigma-eval; grdr-core/src/analyze/cmd_posix.rs uses custom dialect lexers rather than brush-parser; grdr-update uses custom TUF verifier; grdr-proto dropped buffa soak (SP-1) in favor of prost + manual KnownFieldTags.

Contract vs Code Drift & Missing Security Isolations: grdr-compat uses hardcoded CompatMatrix::default_v1() ignoring support.toml; grdr-comply::default_registry() hardcodes capabilities/frameworks/crosswalks duplicating packs/compliance/ YAML; programs/grdr/src/audit/mod.rs (grdr audit verify) imports grdr_crypto and grdr_core instead of being an independent zero-grdr-crypto oracle (04-15); crates/grdr-ports-kitkey and crates/grdr-wire-testkit from Doc 03 / deny.toml do not exist; grdr-model::log_safe::DataClass (6 variants) conflicts with canonical grdr-schema::DataClass (4+2).

Unsigned Policy Packs & Disconnected Modules: Only 3 of 14 packs/ subdirectories (essentials, detections, compliance) carry signature.json against packs/trust-roots.toml; grdr-identity/src/locator.rs is production-quality P14 YAML credential hygiene scanning but is disconnected from grdr-agents local discovery.

Cross-OS Peer Auth Failure (Open Issue #130): grdr-peer-os/src/win_acl.rs rejects Windows built-in Local Administrator (LA) SDDL SID on CI Server runners, failing closed on daemon/ACP tests; grdr-sandbox-engine/src/linux.rs cgroup unit test fails on macOS /var -> /private/var temp symlinks.

B.title: Sensor -> Daemon -> Engine/Detect/Intel Runtime Loop Disconnected
B.summary: Platform OS sensors (grdr-sensor-linux, grdr-sensor-macos, grdr-sensor-windows), SigmaDetectionEngine, Cedar Engine::load/step, grdr-intel, and compile_down_* are implemented as isolated unit-tested modules and never hosted by grdr-daemon or grdr-engine.

B.title: Universal Startup Failure Across All Protected Packaging & VM E2E Scripts
B.summary: grdr-daemon rejects --data-dir in Protected mode and lacks --bind/--service flags, yet systemd, launchd, WiX, Helm DaemonSet, grdr-services.json, and VM QA scripts all pass them. Protected mode also prevents spawning grdr-engine/uplink/updater due to missing sibling auto-discovery.

B.title: External Preconditions Separated from Buildable Code Defects
B.summary: While pre-apple-dev, pre-apple-es, pre-win-driver, pre-win-wesp, and pre-win-authenticode remain unmet, major buildable engineering gaps exist independently: Linux eBPF/fanotify/cgroup-net has ZERO [EXT] blockers yet zero kernel programs; macOS EsTreeCoordinator uses FAIL_CLOSED miss mode; Windows ETW skips UserData; sandbox-engine skips AppContainer/WFP.

B.title: Pervasive P14 Hardcoding & Brand/Path Divergence
B.summary: Hardcoded agent lists (AGENT_ANCESTOR_NAMES in dir_guard.rs, KNOWN_WINDOWS_AGENTS in windows_process_parse.rs, codex/claude-code in seatbelt.rs), hardcoded proxy port 18080, hardcoded "Guardrails"/com.guardrailshq.grdr vs io.guardrails. prefixes, and mismatched /var/lib/grdr vs /var/lib/guardrails paths violate P14 and brand.toml single-source rules.

B.title: Daemon <-> Uplink Schema Mismatch & Missing A/B Handover Execution
B.summary: grdr-daemon sends DeviceCheckinRequest JSON where grdr-uplink expects CheckInDirective JSON (containing pre-fetched response_payload), Dialer/reqwest is never invoked by uplink DaemonWorker, and grdr-daemon never executes grdr-updater <=2s handover markers or FD preservation.

C.title: Library Islands Without Endpoint Control-Plane Wiring
C.description: High-rigor Slice C modules (grdr-agents, grdr-broker, grdr-identity, grdr-core::detect::SigmaDetectionEngine, grdr-infer, grdr-proxy, grdr-mcp) compile and pass isolated tests, yet programs/grdr-daemon (Cargo.toml:13-31) does not depend on grdr-agents, grdr-broker, or grdr-identity, programs/grdr-engine (main.rs:168-207) runs only evaluate_with_session without SigmaDetectionEngine or grdr-infer, and programs/grdr CLI (main.rs:101-175, mcp_proxy.rs:20-59) targets non-existent http://127.0.0.1:8788 instead of grdr-wire OS IPC or grdr-mcp.

C.title: Systemic P14 Violations Across 8 Crates/Programs
C.description: Hardcoded vendors, secret prefixes, regexes, Windows paths, and brand strings break data-driven extensibility and white-labeling: (1) grdr-agents hardcoded 7 agents, 5 Windows names, 3 HookTargetKind variants, guardrails-adr; (2) grdr-hook closed 5-variant HookDialect + ProgramData\Guardrails path; (3) grdr-broker DEFAULT_BRAND & SECRET_PREFIXES; (4) content_rules.rs 17 LazyLock secret/PII regexes instead of packs/secrets/; (5) grdr-sandbox-engine hardcoded sensitive env keys; (6) grdr-llm-proto closed 8-variant ProviderFamily switches alongside providers.json; (7) grdr-proxy/otlp.rs, grdr-export, grdr-core/detect/l0.rs, and grdr-review/nl2cedar.rs hardcoded arrays/rules.

C.title: Assurance Over-Claim & Canary-Free Hook Install (#119 Defect)
C.description: crates/grdr-agents/src/discover.rs:416 classifies hooks under InstallProfile::Protected as ControlStrength::ScopedBoundary (AL3) with hardcoded OnFailure::Open (line 424) instead of ControlStrength::Request (AL2), violating P1/P13, while install.rs:115 marks HookInstallState::Effective immediately with no passive SessionStart canary.

C.title: Missing 4-Pass Discovery, Doc 06 K1-K6 Attribution & Expectation Reconciliation
C.description: packs/catalogue/, packs/building-blocks/, Pass 2-3 behavioral classifiers, Doc 06 K1-K6 correlation joins, grades 0-4, attribution-hops packs, and hook-vs-OS housekeeping reconciliation do not exist yet, preventing shared-host disambiguation and unmatched-effect/hook-dark tamper detections.

C.title: Selective TLS MITM Interception Incomplete on CONNECT Tunnels (N3.1)
C.description: grdr-proxy implements ClientHello SNI/ALPN/ECH inspection (tls_hello.rs), 7-criterion MITM policy (tls_policy.rs), and SWG coexistence (swg_coexistence.json), but tunnel.rs:248-264 fails closed rejecting InterceptTls CONNECT (GRDR-PROXY-0003) because ephemeral leaf-CA rustls termination (N3.1) is not implemented.

C.title: Stubbed Edge Helpers: grdr-approve (Interactive G1/G2) & grdr-infer (ONNX)
C.description: programs/grdr-approve/src/main.rs:1-130 is a CLI JSON preview printer with demo fixtures (no OS native UI, Windows separate-desktop G2, or WebAuthn/grant IPC), and programs/grdr-infer/src/detector.rs:30-31 uses HeuristicJudgeDetector with zero ONNX/ML execution.

C.title: Missing Remote Server Ingress Surfaces & Federation Endpoints
C.description: programs/grdr-server/src/routes.rs exposes Connect UI/Operator RPCs (with demo fallbacks in surfaces_provider.rs/connect_mdm.rs) but lacks Doc 17 /v1/guard + AuthZEN + gateway adapters, Doc 23 /mcp propose-only remote server, Doc 17 browser extension, and Doc 15/21 OIDC/SAML BFF, SCIM, SSF/CAEP, and ID-JAG federation.

C.title: MIT Axiomatic Design Coupling Across FR -> DP Boundaries
C.description: Independent functional requirements (adding an agent catalogue entry, adding a hook dialect, changing white-label brand paths, updating secret regexes, adding an LLM wire dialect) are coupled across shared Rust enums/constants rather than clean 1-to-1 pack/manifest DPs, while execution isolation separates policy evaluation cleanly in core without live daemon/engine wiring.

D.title: Mock / Seeded Production Data Masquerading as Live Telemetry
D.summary: HomePage.tsx hardcodes VELOCITY_DAYS (169 / Allowed 156 / Ask 8 / Blocked 5), grdr-desktop/tray/approve run purely over AppVm::demo() / hardcoded metrics (169, 8F2KQ-M41TZW) with zero daemon IPC, connect_mdm.rs hardcodes DEMO_ORIGIN, and server surfaces_comply_seed.rs / surfaces_provider.rs / surfaces_operator_ops.rs unconditionally seed fake orgs, legal holds, DSRs, and mock integrations without gating on --demo-seed.

D.title: Disconnected Kill-Switch Matrix UI Silently Drops User Selections
D.summary: KillSwitchControls.tsx renders agent/model/gateway checkbox matrices, then invokes onTrigger("kill") without passing blockedAgents, blockedModels, or blockedGateways; RespondPage.tsx submits only { action, scope, target_id, reason }, silently discarding every granular choice the operator checked.

D.title: P14 Static Agent/Provider Hardcoding Across Web, Desktop Icons, Coverage & Kill-Switch
D.summary: Tracked openly in #119 and #130: CoveragePage.tsx#L6 freezes 4 MATRIX_AGENTS, KillSwitchControls.tsx#L21-L23 freezes 8 endpoints / 6 models / 6 gateways, web brand-icons.tsx HarnessIcon and desktop/kit.rs agent_glyph switch on hardcoded agent strings instead of querying manifest/icons catalogue dynamically.

D.title: Auth Plane Still Uses SessionStorage Bearer Tokens & Plaintext Step-Up Header
D.summary: grdr-server initializes principal_tokens empty and enforces static bearer tokens; Web connect.ts stores grdr_api_token in window.sessionStorage and sends plaintext X-Grdr-Step-Up from password inputs in SettingsPrivacyPage and OperatorUpgradesView instead of HttpOnly __Host- BFF cookies, CSRF, OIDC/SAML, and WebAuthn passkeys, creating a two-person approval deadlock in single-token Web Console mode.

D.title: Outbox / Delivery Worker & Integration Execution Loops Missing Server-Side
D.summary: grdr-integrations implements strong SSRF-checked manifests, outbox circuit breaking, SaaS parsers, and CISO Assistant/Probo builders, but grdr-server has no background HTTP/SMTP worker. push_grc_evidence merely increments a queued counter, and notifications (Slack/Teams/PagerDuty/Email), SCIM sync, SaaS polling, importers, VPA callouts, and Wasmtime connectors are missing.

D.title: Interface Contract Drift (AL0-AL4 Terminology, Typography Fonts, Incomplete routes.toml, Inactive i18n)
D.summary: Assurance Levels differ between 00-decisions.md section 3 (AL0 Inventoried / AL1 Observed / AL2 Guided / AL3 Contained / AL4 Enforced) and common.mf2.toml/present.ts/desktop (Observed / App hook / Tool proxy / Sandboxed / Enforced). Typography drifts between Inter+JetBrains Mono (design/27, brand.toml) and DM Sans+IBM Plex Mono (tokens.json, design-check.mjs). routes.toml only lists 12 of ~23 routes; t() ignores locale and formatTimestamp() hardcodes en-US; grdr-interface-gen skips Rune theme JSON (DX-25).

D.title: Missing End-User Surfaces: CodeMirror Cedar, Sigma.js >100 Nodes, Browser Extension, Live Desktop/Tray/Approve
D.summary: ProtectPage uses static <pre> instead of CodeMirror 6 + Cedar lint (WEB-20); FlowGraph lacks Sigma.js >100-node fallback (WEB-19); zero browser extension source exists (WEB-73); REST OpenAPI /v1, PolicyChange GitOps, SDKs, Terraform provider, and stateless /mcp HTTP routes are absent; grdr-desktop, grdr-tray, and grdr-approve have zero daemon IPC or native OS tray/toast/biometric prompt implementations.

D.summary: Console styles.css sets .table-wrap { overflow-x: visible } below 820px expecting table.responsive-table, yet InventoryAgentsSection, InventoryMcpAndSkills, InventorySkillsSection, UserDetailSection, ConnectSection (wave keys), ReplayImpactCard, and SessionStreamTable omit .responsive-table/data-label. evidence: programs/grdr-daemon/src/main.rs accepts ONLY --profile, --data-dir, --state-dir, --decide-endpoint, --local-endpoint, --engine-bin, --uplink-bin, --updater-bin, --server, --isolated, --deployment-id, --pinned-key, --self-test and exposes ZERO HTTP listeners.
deploy/packaging/systemd/grdr-daemon.service & deploy/packaging/launchd/com.guardrailshq.grdr.daemon.plist pass removed --bind, --device-name, --interval-secs.
deploy/packaging/windows/grdr-services.json passes removed --service / --sandboxed flags to grdr-daemon & grdr-engine (grdr-engine only accepts --self-test, --max-sessions, --device-id).

deploy/qa/run-slice0-e2e.sh passes --bind 127.0.0.1:8788 --floor-table ...; programs/grdr/src/main.rs status/check/mcp-proxy/run still default --daemon http://127.0.0.1:8788 HTTP, colliding with grdr-server --operator-bind 127.0.0.1:8788.

evidence: deploy/docker/Containerfile.keys-pkcs11 builds non-existent workspace crate grdr-keys-pkcs11 (also Cargo.toml missing pkcs11 crate).
deploy/docker/Containerfile.server builds/copies only web/apps/console/dist, omitting web/apps/operator/dist, --operator-bind, --operator-web-dir, and :9090 metrics.

deploy/helm/grdr-server/templates/_podspec.tpl exposes port 44444 in Service/NetworkPolicy/Probes while failing to pass --operator-bind 0.0.0.0:44444, --operator-web-dir, or GRDR_OPERATOR_TOKEN env var.
Zero Prometheus /metrics endpoint on :9090 or synthetic O-1 canary watchdog exists in programs/grdr-server/.

E.title: HA Profile Storage Stack Broken for TLS PostgreSQL & S3/SeaweedFS Object Stores
evidence: crates/grdr-rel-postgres/src/wire.rs:96-108 & 131-138 rejects sslmode=require|verify-ca|verify-full and server SSLRequest S with GRDR-PG-0005.
crates/grdr-blob/ only implements FilesystemBlobStore; zero S3-compatible / SeaweedFS / Ceph RGW adapter exists despite compose/ha.yml, Terraform AWS/GCP modules, and D-34 requiring S3.
programs/grdr-server/src/store/persistence.rs:69-100 open_ha runs SqliteLogBus + FilesystemBlobStore rather than JetStream + S3.
programs/grdr/src/server_preflight.rs only checks local POSIX dir writability rather than S3 API, Object Lock, TLS, backup age, keys, or clock skew (20 O-2, 32 OPS-07).

deploy/release/dist.toml points to missing root metadata deploy/release/tuf/1.root.json & deploy/release/sigstore/trusted_root.json.

deploy/packaging/deb/nfpm.yaml & deploy/packaging/rpm/nfpm.yaml omit grdr-daemon, grdr-engine, grdr-proxy, grdr-mcp, grdr-run, grdr-acp, grdr-uplink, grdr-updater; Containerfile.node-sensor runs cargo check without installing compiled .bpf.o files.
grdr airgap build packages only packs/ with a 1-line static THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES and zero container OCI/Helm/docs/binaries/sources/ or server airgap import.

programs/grdr-server/src/store/surfaces_comply_helpers.rs:92 hardcodes pipeline_lag_seconds: 12.

programs/grdr-uplink/src/worker.rs handles local IPC commands without live HTTPS Dialer check-ins; grdr-server/src/routes.rs lacks FleetService Subscribe/Wait/PendingCommands.
programs/grdr-proxy/src/otlp.rs parses 3-field custom RawOtlpPayload JSON instead of full OTLP HTTP/protobuf or gRPC payloads.

GOVERNANCE.md & CONTRIBUTING.md reference broken/missing relative files (COVENANT.md, AI_POLICY.md, MAINTAINERS.md under root instead of docs/governance/; governance/vouched.txt; nonexistent CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, rfcs/, community/health.md).
